IC1.his: Once you’ve got your cast of perfected future characters (from Borrow Hindsight ) in your mind, you can also go back to earlier traumatic memories and relive them in a better way.
IC1.add: There’s even a clinical therapy for this, called [Imagery Rescripting](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/201523223/imagery-rescripting), where a therapist walks you through it at first.

IC2.his: I’d ask for a chronic pain specialist and a written plan for the flare-ups you can see coming, including the new or severe signs that mean you go to the ER right away, but don’t let amelioration of symptoms be the end of the investigation.
IC2.add: While that goes on, two therapies have done well in trials for pain with no injury or disease found behind it: Pain Reprocessing Therapy and Emotional Awareness and Expression Therapy. I go into both in [my somatic guide](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/201523223/pain-that-wont-quit).
